name: Crankshaft
function: Converts the reciprocating motion of the pistons into rotational motion that drives the transmission

name: Camshaft
function: Rotates lobes that open and close the intake and exhaust valves in time with piston movement

name: Piston
function: Transfers the force of expanding combustion gases to the connecting rod and crankshaft

name: Alternator
function: Driven by the engine belt to generate electrical power and recharge the battery

name: Radiator
function: Dissipates heat from engine coolant to the air, keeping operating temperature in range

name: Fuel Injector
function: Sprays a metered, atomized amount of fuel into the intake port or cylinder for combustion

name: Brake Caliper
function: Clamps the brake pads against the rotor using hydraulic pressure to slow the wheel

name: Shock Absorber
function: Damps spring oscillation from road inputs to keep the tire in contact with the road

name: Catalytic Converter
function: Uses precious-metal catalysts to convert exhaust pollutants into less harmful gases

name: Connecting Rod
function: Changes the up-and-down (reciprocating) movement of the piston into the circular (rotary) rotation of the crankshaft
